users._description: User profile. Readable/writable by self or admin.

tanks._description: One tank per user. Doc ID itself is the ownership check.

batches._description: Flat collection, scoped by tankId field (== owner uid).

sampling_records._description: Flat collection, scoped by tankId field.

mortality_records._description: Flat collection, scoped by tankId field.

harvest_records._description: Flat collection, scoped by tankId field.

sensorThresholds._description: Per-user sensor range/threshold config. Also mirrored to sensorThresholds/default for ESP32 firmware polling.

system_config._description: Admin-managed system settings. Any signed-in user can read (dashboard needs it).

notifications._description: Flat collection, scoped by uid field.

notifMarkers._description: Scoped by uid field. Tracks last-seen notification markers.

sensorConfig._description: ESP32 uploads its current calibration values on boot (write-only, unauthenticated). Admin-only read.

currentOwner._description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for who the hardware is currently assigned to.

hardware_system._description: Admin writes to assign/reassign the one shared hardware package. Any signed-in user can read.

current._description: ESP32 writes here directly (anonymous, fixed path — no hardwareId, since there's only one device). Admin-only read/delete. Cloud Functions read this and route/copy to sensorReadings/{ownerUid} using hardware_system/currentOwner.uid at write time.

history._description: ESP32 appends every ~60s (anonymous create-only). Admin-only read.

sensorReadings._id: ownerUid  <-- doc ID IS the owner, enforced by the path itself
sensorReadings._description: Latest reading per owner. Written exclusively by Cloud Functions (never directly by ESP32). Readable only by that owner or an admin.

docs._description: Cloud-Function-written historical readings. Reassigning hardware creates NEW history under the new owner — the previous owner's history is never moved/deleted, giving permanent per-owner isolation.

feederSchedules._description: Device owner (Flutter) reads/writes. ESP32 polls (read only, anonymous).

feederLogs._description: ESP32 + Flutter both create. Only device owner/admin can read/update/delete.

feederCommands._description: Device owner creates commands. ESP32 reads & deletes processed commands (anonymous).

feederStatus._description: ESP32 writes status (anonymous). Only device owner/admin reads.

feederDispatched._description: Flutter-only. Tracks which feeding schedules already fired today.

deviceModes._description: Device owner (Flutter) writes control modes. ESP32 reads (anonymous).

deviceLogs._description: Flutter-only activity log. No ESP32 involvement.

mlPredictions._description: Any signed-in user can read. Created/updated by Cloud Functions / ML pipeline.

healthRisk._description: Water-quality/health-risk prediction result per user. Readable by that user or admin.
